name: Devine Impex Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Devine Impex Ltd is in the business of gems and jewellery[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
DIL was previously engaged in manufacturing and exporting products like earthing accessories, valve accessories, electrical wiring accessories, and brass precision components, catering to industries like electrical building and construction. Its exports spanned Europe, the UK, the Middle East, and UAE. The company has since shifted its focus to trading in gold, diamonds, and stocks/shares, now specializing in bullion and gems & jewelry, including items like diamond pendants and gold rings.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.66 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -6.31% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.29% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 237 days.
